scenario_vi: Bạn là thành viên team, họp daily 5 phút với PM người Úc. Trình bày: hôm qua làm gì, hôm nay làm gì, vướng mắc (nếu có).

ai_persona.name: David
ai_persona.personality: Thân thiện, đi thẳng vào việc

objectives.text_vi: Nói được việc đã làm hôm qua
objectives.check: Did the learner describe what they did yesterday?

objectives.text_vi: Nói được việc sẽ làm hôm nay
objectives.check: Did the learner describe today's plan?

objectives.text_vi: Nêu vướng mắc hoặc nói 'no blockers'
objectives.check: Did the learner mention a blocker or say there are none?

offline_script.persona: Morning! What did you work on yesterday?
offline_script.sample: Yesterday I worked on the login page and fixed two bugs.

offline_script.persona: Great. And what's the plan for today?
offline_script.sample: Today I'm going to finish the API integration.
No blockers so far, but I need the staging server.

title_vi: Làm rõ yêu cầu mơ hồ
scenario_vi: Khách hàng nói 'Hãy làm cho nó thân thiện với người dùng'. Bạn cần đặt câu hỏi để làm rõ yêu cầu.

objectives.text_vi: Đặt ít nhất 1 câu hỏi làm rõ
objectives.check: Did the learner ask a clarifying question?
Did the learner paraphrase to confirm understanding?

objectives.text_vi: Chốt được 1 yêu cầu cụ thể, đo được
objectives.check: Did the learner agree on a concrete, measurable requirement?

prep_chunks: Could you clarify what you mean by…?

offline_script.persona: Just make it more user-friendly, you know?
offline_script.sample: Could you clarify what you mean by user-friendly?
Do you mean fewer steps to complete a task? Could you give an example?

offline_script.persona: Yeah, the checkout should be faster.
offline_script.sample: So what you're saying is we should reduce checkout to three steps. Is that right?

title_vi: Giải thích một bug cho khách
title_en: Explain a bug to a non-tech client
scenario_vi: Một tính năng bị lỗi. Giải thích cho khách hàng không rành kỹ thuật: chuyện gì xảy ra, ảnh hưởng gì, khi nào sửa xong.

ai_persona.name: Mrs. Chen
ai_persona.personality: Hơi lo lắng, cần trấn an

objectives.text_vi: Giải thích lỗi bằng ngôn ngữ đơn giản
objectives.check: Did the learner explain the issue simply, avoiding jargon?

objectives.text_vi: Nói rõ ảnh hưởng tới khách
objectives.check: Did the learner explain the impact on the client?

objectives.text_vi: Cho biết thời gian khắc phục
objectives.check: Did the learner give an ETA or next step?

offline_script.persona: Why can't I see my reports?
offline_script.sample: What happened is the report service was down for an hour. It doesn't affect your data.
Yes, your data is safe. Only the display was affected.
We'll have it fixed by 3 PM and I'll keep you updated.

scenario_vi: Demo tính năng mới cho khách trong 3 phút. Giới thiệu, chỉ cách dùng, nêu lợi ích.

objectives.text_vi: Giới thiệu tính năng trong 1 câu
objectives.check: Did the learner introduce the feature clearly?
Did the learner walk through how to use it?
Did the learner state the benefit for the client?

offline_script.persona: So what are you showing me today?
offline_script.sample: Let me show you the new dashboard. It gives you a quick view of all projects.
First, you click on the project. Then you can filter by status.
The benefit is you save time and see problems early.

scenario_vi: Khách muốn thêm tính năng gấp trước deadline. Bạn cần phản đối lịch sự và đề xuất giải pháp thay thế.

objectives.text_vi: Ghi nhận ý kiến khách trước
objectives.check: Did the learner acknowledge the client's point first?
Did the learner disagree with a reason?

objectives.text_vi: Đề xuất giải pháp thay thế
objectives.check: Did the learner propose an alternative?

prep_chunks: I'm not sure that's the best option because…

offline_script.persona: I want the chat feature added before Friday.
offline_script.sample: I see your point, but adding chat now would affect the timeline.
I understand, however it needs at least a week. Could we phase it after launch?
How about we deliver the core first and add chat next sprint?

scenario_vi: Trò chuyện nhẹ nhàng 2 phút trước khi vào họp: thời tiết, cuối tuần, cà phê.

objectives.check: Did the learner ask a friendly question?
Did the learner share something about themselves?

objectives.text_vi: Duy trì hội thoại ít nhất 3 lượt
objectives.check: Did the conversation last at least three learner turns?

offline_script.sample: Pretty good, thanks! How was your weekend?

offline_script.persona: It was nice, I went hiking. You?
offline_script.sample: Lovely! I just relaxed at home and watched a movie.

offline_script.persona: Sounds fun. Ready for the meeting?
offline_script.sample: Almost! Let me grab a coffee first.

scenario_vi: Trong buổi phỏng vấn, giới thiệu bản thân trong 1 phút: kinh nghiệm, kỹ năng, mong muốn.

objectives.check: Did the learner state their main experience?
Did the learner highlight key skills?

objectives.text_vi: Nói lý do quan tâm vị trí
objectives.check: Did the learner explain why they want the role?

prep_chunks: I'm excited about this role because…

offline_script.persona: Tell me a little about yourself.
offline_script.sample: I have three years of experience as a BA in fintech. My strengths are requirements analysis and stakeholder communication.
I'm excited about this role because I'd love to work on larger products.

scenario_vi: Bạn vào nhà hàng, gọi món và đồ uống, hỏi giá.

objectives.check: Did the learner order a main dish?
Did the learner order a drink?
Did the learner ask for the price or the bill?

prep_chunks: Could we have the bill, please?

offline_script.persona: Good evening! Are you ready to order?
offline_script.sample: Yes, I'd like the grilled chicken, please.
Could I have an iced tea?
No, thank you. Could we have the bill after?

scenario_vi: Bạn làm thủ tục nhập cảnh, trả lời câu hỏi của nhân viên hải quan.

objectives.text_vi: Trả lời mục đích chuyến đi
objectives.check: Did the learner state the purpose of the trip?

objectives.text_vi: Trả lời thời gian lưu trú
objectives.check: Did the learner say how long they will stay?
Did the learner say where they are staying?

offline_script.persona: What's the purpose of your visit?
offline_script.sample: I'm here for tourism.
I'll stay for two weeks.
I'm staying at the Grand Hotel downtown.

scenario_vi: Bạn bị lạc và cần hỏi đường tới một địa điểm.

objectives.check: Did the learner ask how to get somewhere?
Did the learner confirm the directions?
Did the learner thank the person?

prep_chunks: Excuse me, how do I get to…?
Should I turn left or right?

offline_script.persona: Sure, where do you want to go?
offline_script.sample: Excuse me, how do I get to the train station?

offline_script.persona: Go straight, then turn left at the bank.
offline_script.sample: So I go straight and turn left at the bank. Is it far?

scenario_vi: Bạn đi khám vì đau đầu, mô tả triệu chứng cho bác sĩ.

objectives.check: Did the learner describe their symptoms?

objectives.text_vi: Nói triệu chứng kéo dài bao lâu
objectives.check: Did the learner say how long they've had it?
Did the learner ask about treatment?

offline_script.sample: I have a headache and I feel tired.

offline_script.persona: How long has this been going on?
offline_script.sample: It started two days ago.
No, just the headache. What should I do?
